Map showing the locations of sites included in the Contaminated Sites Registry  
  
  This map shows the locations of sites included in the Contaminated Sites Registry. There are three types of sites in the registry: Designated Contaminated, Designated Impacted, and Not Designated.  The data for this map are provided via a web csv file that is maintained by Environment, Climate and Parks staff. For more information visit Environment, Climate and Parks website.
